🎥🎬: Batman: Knightfall – Part 2: Knightquest

After Bane breaks Batman and leaves him unable to protect Gotham, Bruce Wayne is forced to step away from the mantle he has carried for years. With the city still plagued by criminals, Jean-Paul Valley, also known as Azrael, takes up the cowl and becomes Gotham’s new Batman.

At first, Azrael seems capable of filling the void, but his brutal approach to crime quickly separates him from everything Bruce believed Batman should represent. As his obsession with justice turns increasingly violent, Azrael begins transforming the Batman symbol into something darker and more dangerous.

While Bruce focuses on rebuilding his strength and finding a way back, he watches from the sidelines as his replacement loses control. Eventually, Bruce returns to Gotham to reclaim the mantle, setting the stage for a battle not only over the cowl, but over what Batman is supposed to stand for.
